jobs.title: Director, Product Marketing, Life Sciences
jobs.description_text:
Your Impact at LILA

Lila Sciences is hiring a Director, Product Marketing, Life Sciences to own go-to-market for our life science product portfolio. You will set positioning and launch strategy for closed-loop AI and autonomous lab capabilities, including mRNA design, DNA construct optimization, and AI-driven medicinal chemistry.

The audience is senior and technical: biopharma and advanced therapy companies, R&D and CMC leaders, data science teams, and scientific IT. Your job is to make complex science legible and commercially compelling, then build the evidence that moves prospects from curiosity to committed programs.

You will work as an individual contributor embedded with the LS Product team, partnering closely with Commercial, Business Development, and Brand. Success looks like a coherent portfolio narrative, a real plan behind every major capability launch, and a field team equipped to sell.

What You'll Be Building

  • Own go-to-market strategy for the full life science product portfolio
  • Define positioning for RNA, DNA, protein, and small molecule capabilities
  • Lead launches end to end, from pilot framing through general availability and expansion
  • Build offer constructs with Product and Commercial, including pilot scopes and access models
  • Turn pilots into case studies that show measurable scientific impact
  • Equip Commercial and BD with narrative decks

jobs.title: Engineer I/II, Research Operations (1st shift)
jobs.description_text:
Your Impact at LILA

Lila Sciences’ Research Operations team executes the automated laboratory workflows that power our scientific platform. We are seeking a versatile and detail-oriented Engineer I/II who can quickly learn and independently execute high-throughput workflows across a range of biological applications, including DNA, RNA, mRNA, protein, and cell-based workflows.

You will remain part of Research Operations while working closely with a cross-functional team of scientists and engineers, providing the scientific and operational context needed to execute, evaluate, and improve laboratory systems. You will operate laboratory automation and instrumentation, monitor workflow performance and quality-control results, troubleshoot issues, maintain operational readiness, and translate workflow observations into improvements that strengthen reliability and scalability.

This is an on-site, first-shift role, with scheduled hours of either 7:00 AM to 3:00 PM or 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM based on operational needs. Level will be determined based on experience, technical breadth, and demonstrated independence.

What You'll Be Building

  • Independently execute high-throughput automated and manual workflows across DNA, RNA, mRNA, protein, cell-based, and other biological applications.
  • Prepare and verify reagents, samples, labware, and consumables required for workflow execution.
  • Operate liquid hand

jobs.title: Engineer II/ Senior Engineer, Robotics Platform Evaluation
jobs.description_text:
Your Impact at LILA

Lila is building a dedicated platform evaluation function within our robotics organization. The team tests and benchmarks alternative robotics platforms, including mobile manipulators, AMRs and AGVs, and other form factors, against our current production baseline. Consistent methodology across platforms is the point: results have to be directly comparable to be useful.

As a Robotics Platform Evaluation Engineer, you own robots end to end. You unbox and commission new hardware, integrate it with our software stack and infrastructure, execute the full test program, and turn the results into decision-ready comparisons that inform which platforms we adopt.

This is a hands-on, systems-level role. You will be in the lab working directly with hardware, not reviewing spec sheets. You will also shape the evaluation methodology and the tooling behind it, so each platform assessment runs faster and more consistently than the last.

What You'll Be Building

  • Commission new robotics platforms from unboxing through integration with our stack
  • Own end-to-end evaluation of assigned platforms, from test plan to benchmark report
  • Run test suites spanning navigation, manipulation, perception, and controls
  • Integrate platforms with ROS2 and Nav2, adapting drivers, configurations, and interfaces
  • Characterize manipulator, gripper, and AMR/AGV performance against comparabl

jobs.title: Machine Learning Scientist I / II, Protein Design
jobs.description_text:
Your Impact at LILA

Lila is building a platform where AI and automation co-evolve to solve the hardest problems in medicine. Within Life Sciences AI, the AI for Protein Engineering team builds models and systems that take a biologic from design specification to wet-lab validated lead.

We're hiring a machine learning scientist to design molecules on real programs and turn what they learn into capabilities that generalize across programs. The ideal candidate is an exceptional builder with strong biological intuition: someone who can turn work on individual campaigns into reliable, extensible systems that improve how we design molecules across programs. You'll work closely with domain scientists, platform teams, and AI researchers to connect specialist protein design models to Lila's broader autonomous science platform.

What You'll Be Building

  • Design molecules for active biologics programs, partnering with domain scientists to translate target, mechanism, and experimental constraints into actionable design hypotheses.
  • Develop reasoning capabilities for drug discovery, including orchestrating design workflows.
  • Design and maintain benchmarks and evaluation infrastructure that measure whether design workflows produce useful, generalizable decisions across biologics programs.
  • Own operations around reproducibility, throughput, and inference cost of computational design workflows.

Lila is building a platform where AI and automation co-evolve to solve the hardest problems in medicine. Within Life Sciences AI, the AI for Protein Engineering team develops and applies generative and predictive models that move biomolecule design programs from in silico hypothesis to wet-lab validated leads.

We are looking for an ML Scientist I/II focused on AI for protein engineering. The work spans active protein engineering programs and focused technology development that improves how Lila designs, evaluates, and learns from biomolecular sequence, structure, and function data.

This role sits at the intersection of machine learning, protein engineering, and therapeutic design. The ideal candidate brings strong ML fundamentals, curiosity about protein biology, and interest in computationally designed, wet-lab-validated biologics. You’ll collaborate with experimental scientists, AI researchers, and platform teams to build models and workflows that support Lila’s broader autonomous science platform.

What You'll Be Building

  • Build ML workflows for protein engineering campaigns, from design specification through experimental learning.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer, AI Security
jobs.description_text:
Your Impact at LILA

Lila Sciences is building autonomous systems for scientific discovery, and the AI infrastructure behind that work needs security built in from the start. This role sits on the IT & Security team and owns security engineering for Lila's AI and ML systems, from training and inference pipelines to model registries, MCP servers, and agent runtimes.

As the senior individual contributor for AI security, you will translate the AI security roadmap into delivered controls, drive vulnerability remediation to closure, and reduce risk across the full AI lifecycle: data, models, pipelines, and agentic systems. The work is hands on, with technical depth across cloud security, supply chain security, and AI-specific threat models.

The role is deeply cross-functional. You will partner with AI Platform, AI Research, ML Operations, Science, and AI Safety so security shows up at design time rather than after the fact. Success looks like AI infrastructure that stays continuously compliant, measurable reduction in open risk, and engineering teams that treat security as part of how they build.

What You'll Be Building

  • Turn the AI security roadmap into delivered controls with measurable outcomes
  • Design and implement security controls across training and inference pipelines, model registries, MCP servers, and agent runtimes

jobs.title: Principal Network Engineer
jobs.description_text:
Your Impact at LILA

Lila's science factories run on a fast-growing, multi-site network that spans corporate offices, autonomous labs, and OT/robotics environments across Cambridge (Alewife), OCP, San Francisco, and London. As Principal Network Engineer, you will be the senior technical owner of that network: building the in-house engineering capability to design, secure, and scale it, while increasing the value and effectiveness of our managed service provider relationships.

You'll partner closely with Identity, Endpoints, Security, and OT/Controls engineering teams as we build the corporate engineering function. You’ll have real influence over the network architecture decisions that determine how quickly and safely we can bring new labs and AI Science Factories online.

This is a hands-on, senior IC role for someone who can set technical direction, operate deeply in the details, and shape the network engineering function as it matures.

What You'll Be Building

  • Own the architecture, design, and roadmap for Lila’s global network, including SD-WAN/SASE, enterprise firewalls, and secure remote access.
  • Lead VLAN, subnet, and segmentation design across corporate IT, lab, and OT environments.
  • Design IT/OT convergence patterns that keep production labs safe, segmented, observable, and reliable.
  • Drive network infrastructure migration and hardening, including firewall-to-SASE cutover

The Chemistry AISF spans a broad array of domains including molecular chemistry and small-molecule synthesis, targeted drug delivery and LNP formulation, colloidal nanochemistry and quantum materials, and the flow-chemistry and analytical backbone that connects them.

We are hiring a Product Manager to own the product layer for the Chemistry AISF; deciding which capabilities we build, in what order, to what specification, and how we know they are working. You will partner with the Chemistry AISF Program Lead, who owns scientific direction, and with AISF Engineering, which owns the build. Your lane is the what and the why: turning commercial pull, scientific ambition, and AI model needs into a prioritized capability roadmap, and then into requirements crisp enough that engineering teams can scope, staff, and execute against them.

  • Set the product vision, roadmap, and capability priorities for the Chemistry AISF, spanning molecular chemistry and small-molecule synthesis, targeted drug delivery and formulation, colloidal nanochemistry, and the shared analytical backbone.

jobs.description_text:
Your Impact at LILA

The Robotics Operations Engineer supports deployment and day-to-day operation of Lila’s production robot fleet. This role is the front-line technical presence for robots operating in production environments, ensuring safe, reliable operation and rapid response when issues arise.

You’ll monitor live robot operations, perform hands-on troubleshooting, document incidents clearly, and partner with robotics software and hardware teams to improve uptime. The role is based in a lab production environment and will help support expanded fleet operating hours as the team scales. This role begins on a standard 9am-5pm schedule and transitions to first shift coverage, 6am-2pm, as fleet operating hours expand.

  • Monitor robot behavior during live production operations.
  • Intervene quickly and safely to pause, stop, or reset robots when needed.

  • Perform minor robot maintenance, including cabling, sensor swaps, fasteners, and basic component replacement.
  • Execute robot swap procedures, validate spare units, and return robots to production readiness.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer II, Robotics Mechanical Design
jobs.description_text:
Your Impact at LILA

Our Platform Evaluation team tests and benchmarks alternative robotics platforms, including mobile manipulators, AMRs/AGVs, and other form factors, against our current production baseline. The team builds custom mobile manipulators by combining off-the-shelf components from different AMR and robot arm manufacturers, for example mounting one or more arms from a given vendor onto an AMR base from another.

As the Robotics Mechanical Design Engineer, you will own the mechanical design of these custom configurations end to end: mocking up multiple iterations (different arm brands, mounting positions, and configurations), modeling them fully in CAD, and preparing designs for simulation and physical build.

You will work closely with the Platform Evaluation engineers, who validate designs in simulation (NVIDIA Isaac Sim) and in physical testing once built. This is a hands-on mechanical and mechatronic design role, not a robotics software or controls position.

What You'll Be Building

  • Design and iterate mounting and integration concepts combining robot arms with AMR/AGV base platforms
  • Produce multiple design options per platform combination for evaluation
  • Model custom mobile manipulator configurations in CAD, including brackets, structural supports, and interface hardware
  • Run mass, center-of-gravity, and payload analysis to keep configurations within manufacturer

About MSF USA | Doctors Without Borders

 

Doctors Without Borders/Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an independent international organization that provides medical care to the people who need it most. The organization cares for people affected by conflict, disease outbreaks, disasters, and social exclusion in more than 70 countries. MSF offers medical humanitarian assistance solely based on need, regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, or politics. Our international project teams include medical, logistical, and administrative staff, most of them hired locally and working with their own communities. Our actions are guided by medical ethics and the principles of independence, impartiality, and neutrality. We also bear witness and speak out about the experiences of our colleagues and patients.

About Moment Energy

Independent energy is here. Help us deploy it.

Energy should be free.  Free from aging grids, fragile supply chains, and unnecessary extraction. At Moment Energy, we’re building a world where clean power is abundant, affordable, and uninterrupted for everyone.

The world doesn’t need another promise about energy; it needs proof that a freer future is possible. Moment Energy is the pragmatic liberator of power, the only company certified to turn the largest untapped energy supply into independent energy.

Now is the moment. While the industry scraps millions of batteries with decades of life left, we put them to work by repurposing large-format batteries into advanced battery energy storage systems that deliver real-world impact.

We were told second-life batteries would never be safe enough or scalable enough. We didn’t argue, we engineered the solution. Today, Moment Energy delivers 5x the energy density and holds the certifications required to deploy energy independence at scale.

Now is the moment. Join us.

Want to make a positive impact on the world?

We are creating devices that enable a bi-directional interface with the brain. These devices allow us to restore movement to the paralyzed, restore sight to the blind, and revolutionize how humans interact with their digital world.

The Role

Neuralink’s next generation surgical robot will perform brain surgery at scale, installing hundreds of tiny threads into the brain to enable brain computer communication.

  • The success of the project is on you. You talk to users, get feedback, and iterate fast.

Note: The team is hiring engineers at all levels, both junior and senior. What matters most is evidence of exceptional abilities and a drive to succeed.

About NewsBreak

Local life runs on local information. What happened down the street? Who can fix this? Where should we go tonight? NewsBreak started in 2015 to answer these questions, and today more than 40 million people a month rely on us to follow what’s going on in their zip code.

Three platforms with one vision: powering local life. Led by founder and CEO Jeff Zheng, NewsBreak is our local life and news platform; Nearby AI connects people with local businesses; and NDot AI helps publishers and creators grow and earn.

Building for the long term. A $115 million Series C made us a unicorn in 2021, and we keep investing in our people. We’re Great Place to Work® certified and named to Fast Company’s Best Workplaces for Innovators (2025) and Fortune’s Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™ (2026).

Everyone makes an impact. Whether you write code, shape products, tell our story, or run the business, we want people who own projects end to end, stay curious, and speak up. Join us.

Learn more at: NewsBreak, Nearby AI, NDot AI

About the role

NewsBreak is building ReelBee, an open short-drama distribution platform where any qualified creator or studio can self-publish, earn a transparent revenue share, and get real US audience insights. This is a CEO-sponsored, company-level initiative.

jobs.title: Remote Sensing Data Scientist
jobs.description_text:
About the role

Muon Space is building a family of infrared imaging missions designed for global wildfire detection and monitoring, weather and cloud characterization, and space-based environmental monitoring. Muon's IR Data Products team builds the analytics system that processes the data from our spacecraft's custom multispectral imaging instruments into data products and analytics for diverse end-user stakeholders from these missions. We are seeking a Geospatial Data Scientist to join this team with a focus on building derived data products from Muon's FireSat and Space-Based Environmental Monitoring (SBEM) missions. 

This role will be a hands-on contributor to the development of derived data products from Muon's IR data missions. You will dive deep into real-world data from brand new imaging systems, prototype and productionize algorithms that turn Level-1 imagery into higher-level derived products, and write production-ready code that feeds directly into customer-facing services. Working alongside senior scientists and product owners on the IR Data Products team, you will build expertise across both missions while contributing to product design, validation, and documentation. This is a high-impact, multi-mission role that sits at the intersection of rigorous Earth observation science and fast-moving product development, and is well-suited for someone who thrives on hands-on technical work and cross-functional collaboration.

About the role

Muon seeks a Senior Mechanical Engineer to own the mechanical direction of a spacecraft subsystem or mission from requirements definition to installation on the launch vehicle. jobs.title: Electrical Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description_text:
K2 is building the largest and highest-power satellites ever flown, unlocking performance levels previously out of reach across every orbit. Backed by over $1 billion in total funding from leading investors including Altimeter Capital, ICONIQ, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, and T. Rowe Price — and with over $1 billion in signed contracts across commercial and US government customers, we're mass-producing the highest-power satellite platforms ever built for missions from LEO to deep space.

The rise of heavy-lift launch vehicles is shifting the industry from an era of mass constraint to one of mass abundance, and we believe this new era demands a fundamentally different class of spacecraft. Engineered to survive the harshest radiation environments and to fully capitalize on today's and tomorrow's massive rockets, K2 satellites deliver unmatched capability at constellation scale and across multiple orbits.

With multiple launches in 2027 and plans to scale to 100 satellites a year, we're Building Bigger — helping develop the solar system and build toward a Kardashev Type II (K2) civilization. If you are a motivated individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment and you're excited about contributing to the success of a high-growth Series D-funded company, we'd love for you to apply.

With multiple launches in 2027 and plans to scale to 100 satellites a year, we're Building Bigger — helping develop the solar system and build toward a Kardashev Type II (K2) civilization. jobs.description_text:
Maven Clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. Through Maven Enterprise, the company partners with more than 2,300 employers and health plans to provide end-to-end women's and family health programs spanning fertility and family building, maternity and newborn care, parenting and pediatrics, and menopause and midlife — improving clinical outcomes, reducing healthcare costs, and expanding equitable access to high-quality care at scale. Through its consumer platform, Maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and GLP-1 care programs purpose-built for women.
